data.description:
## Description
plugins/dso/scripts/assert-batch-branch.sh has 7 references to per-branch-review.yml in user-visible error messages and inline comments explaining why the push-to-origin invariant matters (the workflow fires on push). The workflow was deleted in commit 4b18d2d644 (story 20d7-09d6). Error messages are now misleading.

## Impact
P3 — misleading error messages when the push invariant is violated.

## Fix
Audit whether the push-to-origin gate in assert-batch-branch.sh is still needed and for what consumer. Update or remove the per-branch-review.yml references in error messages.

## Found By
completion-verifier during story 20d7-09d6 closure
data.title: assert-batch-branch.sh error messages cite deleted per-branch-review.yml as rationale
